purpose: Explicit source-disposition joins for every discovered app route/layout/state entry and separately identified global/shared/dormant/protected surface family. Specialized admin delegation joins by exact source entry; global families identify their own source arrays/pointers and may overlap concrete file entries. Owner ledgers retain consumer graphs, benefit, contracts and checks.
limits: Page counts exclude layouts/loading/error/global-state entries. Separately joined global surface families may overlap concrete source files; specialized entries overlap admin routes. None of these dimensions is added as unique or visually verified product screens.
Structured inspection and an evidenced retention reason do not prove every productive state renders.
Runtime indexes are authoritative for actual captures, failed states and exclusions; current after review is attributed in source reviews and exact final gates remain separately root-owned.
